compiled_state.title: Ticket CLI: ticket edit does not support --parent -> cannot re-parent tickets after creation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** cab670aeac0b2fe0fc97c007b2e33076a02c3418
* **Active Workflow:** /dso:brainstorm Phase 3 ticket integration; also impacts /dso:preplanning and any workflow that needs to move a ticket to a new parent

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Missing capability — needed during routine epic decomposition.

#### Expected Behavior

`.claude/scripts/dso ticket edit <id> --parent <new-parent-id>` should update the ticket's `parent_id` field to the new parent, preserving the ticket's identity, history, comments, links, and tags. This is needed any time a brainstorm or preplanning session decides to re-parent an existing ticket — common when:

* An epic is split into child epics and existing stories under the umbrella belong under a new child epic
* Stories are moved from one epic to another during scope refinement
* Tickets created under a draft umbrella later need to be re-homed under a more specific parent

#### Actual Behavior

`ticket edit` rejects `--parent` with the error:

```
Error: unknown field 'parent'. Allowed: title priority assignee ticket_type description tags
```

The `parent_id` field is set at ticket-create time only. There is no other CLI subcommand for moving a ticket to a new parent (no `reparent`, no `move`, no `set-parent`).

This forced a workaround during brainstorm of epic e7f3-2b45-8d7d-4c68 (grainy-speck-ball) on 2026-05-14: Stories 1ef8-79c4 (Story A — proximity matcher) and 0b1b-8177 (Story B — relation enforcement) are scoped under child epic c15a-9012 (Cycle-end arbiter + workflow unification) but remain parented to the umbrella because the CLI cannot move them. The workaround was: add a comment on each story documenting the de-facto parent, plus a `depends_on` link between the new parent epic and the story.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:** Attempted `ticket edit 1ef8-79c4-6195-4c98 --parent c15a-9012-3ef4-47b1` and `ticket edit 0b1b-8177-db5e-4055 --parent c15a-9012-3ef4-47b1` during brainstorm Phase 3. Both rejected with the unknown-field error.
* **Known Workarounds:**
  * Add a PARENT NOTE comment on the misparented ticket documenting the de-facto relationship (applied 2026-05-14 to 1ef8-79c4 and 0b1b-8177)
  * Add an `epic-to-story` or `epic-to-epic` `depends_on` link from the intended parent to the story (applied 2026-05-14 from c15a-9012 to 1ef8-79c4)
  * Alternative destructive workaround: delete the story and recreate it with the new parent (loses history, comments, links, tags — not used)

### 4. Suspected Categories

* CLI subcommand gap (the `parent_id` field exists in the event-sourced ticket model; only the edit-side projection lacks support)
* Possibly a deliberate restriction (re-parenting changes hierarchy semantics — children count, depends_on chains, agent-batch-readiness) but if so, there is no documented alternative path

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** /dso:brainstorm Phase 3
* **Skills Invoked:** ticket-cli (ticket edit, ticket create, ticket link)

### 6. Suggested Resolution

Add `--parent <new-parent-id>` to the `ticket edit` allowed-fields list, emitting a PARENT_CHANGED event in the event log. Validation should reject re-parent operations that would create a cycle in the parent-chain. Add a comment to the ticket-cli-reference.md documenting the new capability and any restrictions (e.g., "closed tickets cannot be re-parented").
